_comment: Ballast loading, from the technical guidelines for Exhibitions in Germany (Adam, 2026-08-27). kg is PER UPRIGHT (per bay support) - the table has no width term because a wider wall gets more uprights, not heavier ones. SAFETY FACTOR 1.5 IS ALREADY APPLIED in the kg column - do not add another. Same table for BOTH ground support systems.
_plateNote: Plate weight and part code live in parts.json under ballastPlate. Plates round UP per upright, then multiply by the upright count - rounding once at the end would under-ballast individual towers.

minHeight._comment: Minimum ground-support wall height per system (Adam). Uniview's 1.5m is below the table's first row, so it clamps up to the 2.0m figure.

_maxHeightNote: Ground-supported walls above this are rejected - off the end of the table, needs engineering sign-off. Raise only with a longer table.
